_comment: The MLX preset compiles a drafter for an MLX target. The QAT drafter's MLX conversion (mlx-community/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-assistant-4bit) is 4-bit throughout, the embedding its target lends included; Google's bf16 drafter keeps its own weights dense under it, only the lent embedding the target's 4-bit triple (that stem's preset overrides).
